title_en: Priority area 5: Care for Yourself, Care for Others
objectives_fil: Makinig nang may paggalang, tanungin kung anong tulong ang kailangan, at ipaliwanag ang nasuring suporta sa komunidad.
Suriin ang agarang kaligtasan ayon sa protocol, panatilihin ang pribadong usapan, at gamitin ang angkop na referral route.
objectives_en: Given a resident's concern, use supportive language and identify a reviewed self/community support step.
Given a fictional urgent or non-urgent mental-health situation, choose the verified referral and handover route.
summary_fil: Alagaan ang sarili at kapwa: 2 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 5: Care for Yourself, Care for Others: 2 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
